The simulator's separate call-date window (2022-01-01 to 2024-06-12, the same window that produced settled_control and test1_zero_info_floor) names which transcript events those same rows describe. Both axes describe the same underlying 362 rows; this is not two different corpora.

settled_control.kind: forward draw (single deterministic replay, not a median across draws)

test1_zero_info_floor.kind: forward draw (deterministic replay, every verdict forced Hold)
test1_zero_info_floor.note: This is NOT Arm 0b. test1_zero_info_floor forces every TREND VERDICT to Hold (i.e. corrupts final_action via the trend layer's own Hold-forcing), while Arm 0b (this prompt, Sec5) sets final_action = Hold directly for every call, bypassing the trend layer's verdict machinery entirely. They may or may not coincide numerically; this run does not assume they do and will report both.

arms.PREMISE_CORRECTION: sweep_funding_modes.py's main() grid does NOT contain the settled-config cell (its cells are no_reserve/cash_reserve/swap_funding at 0/5/10/20pp limits; none uses the settled X=2.5pp session limit). The actual settled-configuration production driver, confirmed against tier_return_attribution.py (which asserts EXPECTED_CONTROL = $179,944.91 to the cent), is sweep_cadence_and_session_model.py's run_session_sweep_cell() called with CELL = dict(cadence='30', scope='new_calls_only', funding_mode='swap_funding', limit_pp=2.5, execution_order='pooled', trim_budget_scope='per_event_date', veto_p=0.0), phase_offset=0, seed=0, over events from load_events_dedup_on(). value_attribution_v2_driver.py uses this path and asserts the unmodified control reproduces $179,944.91 before running Arms 0b/0.

arm_0b_universe_only.definition: final_action forced to 'Hold' for every call event, real allocator (decide_v3 via run_session_sweep_cell's swap_funding path), settled config (CELL above), full corpus from load_events_dedup_on(). Override happens AFTER recompute_trend_layer() (inside load_events_dedup_on()) has already computed the real trend verdict and final_action, so this is a direct final_action substitution discarding that verdict -- not a per_call_rec or trend-verdict corruption (distinguishing it from test1_zero_info_floor; see window_and_control note above). run_session_sweep_cell computes final_action = event.final_action or event.per_call_rec or 'Hold' at simulation time (line 782), so overwriting event.final_action beforehand is the correct injection point. Starter sizing still fires: starter_fired = is_first_call and not had_position (does not read final_action).

arm_0_always_bullish.definition: final_action forced to 'Add' for every call event, same override point, real allocator, settled config, same corpus. Expected to saturate against TYPE_A_SPECULATIVE_CAP_PCT 15.0 / TYPE_A_ESTABLISHED_CAP_PCT 35.0 / TYPE_B_CAP_PCT 50.0.
